title: Artifact
description: RFC 0205 §A/§D. An A2A v1.0.1 `Artifact`, transcribed from `specification/a2a.proto` `message Artifact` at tag v1.0.1 (camelCase per A2A spec §5.5). The body of `getArtifact` when it is served as `application/a2a+json` (spec/v2/core/runs.md); `artifactId` equals the path segment. The same shape a2a-integration.md D.3 projects over A2A, so one decoder reads both.

artifactId.description: a2a.proto: "Unique identifier (e.g. UUID) for the artifact. It must be unique within a task." On `getArtifact` it MUST equal the `{artifactId}` path segment.

name.description: a2a.proto: "A human readable name for the artifact."

description.description: a2a.proto: "Optional. A human readable description of the artifact."

parts.description: a2a.proto: "The content of the artifact. Must contain at least one part." A registered artifact's JSON payload is a `data` Part with `mediaType: application/json`.

metadata.description: a2a.proto: "Optional. Metadata included with the artifact." OpenWOP identity for a registered type SHOULD be carried as `metadata.openwop.artifactTypeId` and `metadata.openwop.schemaVersion` (RFC 0205 §A.2).

artifactTypeId.description: The registered artifact type (`artifact.created.artifactType`), bound to the `typeId` kind (identity.md §5).

extensions.description: a2a.proto: "The URIs of extensions that are present or contributed to this Artifact."
